entries.name: Dive Attack
entries: 若你在飛行中且向一個目標直線俯衝至少30呎距離，並接著以一次近戰武器攻擊命中它，該攻擊將對目標造成額外的{@dice 1d6}傷害。

entries.name: Talons
entries: 你熟練於你的徒手打擊，並在以它命中時造成1d4劈砍傷害。

entries.name: Language
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫氣族語。

entries.name: Age
entries: 阿蘭寇拉鷹人3歲時成年。相較於人類，阿蘭寇拉鷹人通常活不過30歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 阿蘭寇拉鷹人大多善良，且鮮少在守序或混亂中選擇立場。部族中的領袖與武者可能屬於守序，而探險者與冒險者則可能傾向混亂。

entries.name: Size
entries: 阿蘭寇拉鷹人大約5呎高。他們有著體重介於80到100磅之間，纖細而輕盈的身體。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Flight
entries: 你擁有50呎的飛行速度。要使用此移動速度，你不能穿著中甲或重甲。

entries.name: Talons
entries: 你熟練於你的徒手打擊，並在命中時造成1d4劈砍傷害。

entries.name: Language
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語、阿蘭寇拉語、和氣族語。

entries.name: Flight
entries: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

entries.name: Talons
entries: You have talons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Wind Caller
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell gust of wind} spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast the spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for when you cast {@spell gust of wind} with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Age
entries: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans but live a few years longer.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aasimar are built like well-proportioned humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 多虧於你的天界血脈，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Celestial Resistance
entries: 你具有對死靈和光耀傷害的抗性。

entries.name: Celestial Legacy
entries: 你知曉{@spell Light||光亮術}戲法。當你升至3級，你可以使用此特性施放一次{@spell Lesser Restoration||次級復原術}，且你在完成一次長休後恢復再次這麼做的能力。當你升至5級，你可以使用此特性以3環法術施放一次{@spell Daylight||晝明術}，且你在完成一次長休後恢復再次這麼做的能力。你施展這些法術的施法屬性為魅力。

entries.name: Language
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和天界語。

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Celestial Resistance
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Healing Hands
entries: As an action, you can touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. The creature regains a number of hit points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Light Bearer
entries: You know the {@spell light} cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

entries.name: Celestial Revelation
entries: When you reach 3rd level, choose one of the revelation options below. Thereafter, you can use a bonus action to unleash the celestial energy within yourself, gaining the benefits of that revelation. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. Once you transform using your revelation below, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

items.name: Necrotic Shroud
items.entry: Your eyes briefly become pools of darkness, and ghostly, flightless wings sprout from your back temporarily. Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Radiant Consumption
items.entry: Searing light temporarily radiates from your eyes and mouth. For the duration, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Radiant Soul
items.entry: Two luminous, spectral wings sprout from your back temporarily. Until the transformation ends, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Celestial Revelation (Necrotic Shroud)

Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

entries: 阿斯莫的成熟速度和人類相同，但他們可以活到最多160歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: Aasimar have the same range of height and weight as humans.

entries: 你知曉{@spell Light||光亮術}戲法。你施展這個法術的施法屬性為魅力。

在變身結束前，於你的每個回合中一次，當你以攻擊或法術對一個目標造成傷害時，你可以對該目標造成額外傷害。額外傷害等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}；若為「黯蝕屍衣」，額外傷害類型為黯蝕，若為「天界之翼」與「內在光輝」則為光耀。
變身選項如下：

items.name: Heavenly Wings
entries: 兩片幽靈般的翅膀暫時從你背上長出。直到變身結束前，你擁有等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}的{@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB|飛行速度}。

items.name: Inner Radiance
entries: 灼熱的光芒暫時從你的雙眼與口中散發出來。在持續時間內，你在 10 呎半徑內發出{@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|明亮光照}，並在其外額外 10 呎發出{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB|微弱光照}；在你的每個回合結束時，你 10 呎內的每個生物受到等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的光耀傷害。

items.name: Necrotic Shroud
entries: 你的雙眼短暫化為兩潭黑暗，無法飛行的翅膀暫時從你背上長出。你 10 呎內除盟友以外的生物，必須通過一次魅力豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你的魅力調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}），否則處於{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態直到你的下個回合結束。

entries.name: Age
entries: Aetherborn come into being as adults and live no more than a few years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: As a rule, aetherborn are driven by hedonism and self-interest, making them neutral at best and thoroughly evil at worst. Neutral aetherborn might devote much of their time (and wealth) to parties and social activity, while evil aetherborn are usually involved in the criminal underworld.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aetherborn are about the same size as humans, ranging from 5 to 6 feet tall. They are quite light—only about 100 pounds—and their weight diminishes as they age and more and more of their substance returns to the aethersphere. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Born of Aether
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and two other languages of your choice.

entries.name: Gift of the Aetherborn
entries: An unknown aetherborn, desperately seeking a means to extend their short life, discovered a process of transformation that prolonged their existence—by giving them the ability to feed on the life essence of other beings. Since then, other aetherborn have learned and carried out this monstrous transformation, and aetherborn with this "gift" have become a small minority among an already small population.

A gifted aetherborn has the ability to drain the life essence of other beings. Similar to the way heat is transferred from a warm object to a cold one, a gifted aetherborn need only touch another living being with a clawed hand to draw life essence out, fueling their own continued existence while draining strength and vitality from their victim.

For many aetherborn, living as they do for indulgence and instant gratification, the concepts of "want" and "need" are virtually synonymous. But Aetherborn with this gift understand what it is to truly need, for they develop a hunger for life essence that far exceeds any desires they might have felt before their transformation. A gifted aetherborn who abstains from this feeding deteriorates even more rapidly than other aetherborn, while enduring unspeakable agony caused by the deprivation of life energy.

At the DM's option, an aetherborn character can research methods of achieving this dark "gift." The process is similar to inventing and manufacturing a rare magic item (see "{@book Inventing and Manufacturing Devices|PS-K|1|Inventing and Manufacturing Devices}" earlier in this document). But rather than aether, the process requires a variety of rare unguents and unusual ingredients that make up the cost of researching and undergoing the transformation.

An aetherborn with this gift gains the Drain Life ability: a natural attack that deals {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage and restores the same number of hit points to the aetherborn. However, if the aetherborn goes for 7 days without dealing this damage, their hit point maximum is reduced by {@dice 1d6} per week. This reduction can't be removed until the aetherborn has used their Drain Life ability and completed a long rest.

items.name: Drain Life
entries: You gain a natural attack that deals {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage and restores the same number of hit points to you. However, if you goes for 7 days without dealing this damage, your hit point maximum is reduced by {@dice 1d6} per week. This reduction can't be removed until you have used your Drain Life ability and completed a long rest.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

entries.name: Astral Fire
entries: You know one of the following cantrips of your choice: {@spell dancing lights}, {@spell light}, or {@spell sacred flame}. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of yourself as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Starlight Step
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Astral Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you remain conscious.

Whenever you finish this trance, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice, selected from the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory and the experiences of entities on the Astral Plane, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Construct.

entries.name: Armored Casing
entries: You are encased in thin metal or some other durable material. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Built for Success
entries: You can add a {@dice d4} to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make, and you can do so after seeing the {@dice d20} roll but before the effects of the roll are resolved. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Healing Machine
entries: If the {@spell mending} spell is cast on you, you can spend a Hit Die, roll it, and regain a number of hit points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 hit point).

In addition, your creator designed you to benefit from several spells that preserve life but that normally don't affect Constructs: {@spell cure wounds}, {@spell healing word}, {@spell mass cure wounds}, {@spell mass healing word}, and {@spell spare the dying}.

entries.name: Mechanical Nature
entries: You have resistance to poison damage and immunity to disease, and you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition poisoned}. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.

entries.name: Sentry's Rest
entries: When you take a long rest, you spend at least 6 hours in an inactive, motionless state, instead of sleeping. In this state, you appear inert, but you remain conscious.

entries.name: Specialized Design
entries: You gain two tool proficiencies of your choice, selected from the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.

entries.name: Age
entries: 與人類相似，艾文在近二十歲時成年，且理論上可以活到80歲。當然，他們大部分在那之前便會光榮（或不光彩的）戰死。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的艾文傾向屬於中立陣營。朱鷺首艾文更崇尚知識勝過其他美德，且通常為絕對中立。鷹首艾文則較為偏向守序中立。

entries.name: Size
entries: 賽壬的身高約為5到6呎，但他們的身軀相當纖細，骨頭部分中空以利飛行。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Flight
entries: 你擁有30呎的飛行速度。你不能在穿著中甲或重甲時使用你的飛行速度。（如果你的戰役使用了負重的變體規則，則你不能在你負載時使用你的飛行速度。）

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和艾文語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Like humans, aven reach adulthood in their late teens and can live into their 80s.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Aven are inclined toward the lawful good alignment of the Church of Serra

entries.name: Size
entries: Aven stand from 5 to 6 feet tall, but their bodies are slender and their bones are partially hollow to facilitate their flight. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying speed of 30 feet. You can't use your flying speed while you wear medium or heavy armor. (If your campaign uses the variant rule for {@variantrule encumbrance|PHB}, you can't use your flying speed if you are encumbered.)

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and {@language Aven|PSD}.

entries.name: Hawkeyed
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill. In addition, attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.

entries.name: Age
entries: Bugbears reach adulthood at age 16 and live up to 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Bugbears live on the fringes of society even in Darguun, where they value self-sufficiency and violence. They are generally chaotic, organizing in loose tribes under charismatic and powerful leaders.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Sneaky
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth} skill.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Sneaky
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth} skill. In addition, without squeezing, you can move through and stop in a space large enough for a Small creature.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you hit a creature with an attack roll, the creature takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage if it hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.

entries.name: Age
entries: 熊地精在16歲時成年，且可以活最多80年。

entries.name: Size
entries: 熊地精的身高介於6到8呎之間，且體重介於250到350磅。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳、推動、或提舉的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。

entries: 你熟練於{@skill Stealth||隱匿}技能。

entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和哥布林語。

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: 你可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

entries.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
entries: 你可以使用狂蛙人語對青蛙與蟾蜍進行簡單概念的溝通。

entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: 你在沼澤地形為躲藏所進行的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries: 你的跳遠距離最多20呎、且跳高距離最多10呎，無論有沒有助跑都一樣。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫狂蛙人語。

entries.name: Age
entries: 半人馬成年跟壽命的速度皆和人類差不多。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 半人馬傾向中立。那些加入瑟雷尼亞的半人馬通常是中立善良，而那些加入古魯的半人馬則大多為混亂中立。

entries.name: Size
entries: 半人馬站立的高度介於6呎到7呎之間，他們馬身的高度則約為4呎。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Fey
entries: 你的生物類型是精類生物，而非類人生物。

entries.name: Charge
entries: 若你朝著目標直線移動至少30呎並接著以近戰武器在同一回合命中它，你可以立刻在該攻擊後以一個附贈動作，使用你的馬蹄對目標進行一次攻擊。

entries.name: Hooves
entries: 你的馬蹄是天生近戰武器，你可以使用它們來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它們命中目標，則你造成等同1d4+你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害，而不是一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Equine Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳或推動的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。
此外，因為你的馬腿，任何需要手和腳的攀爬對你來說都特別困難。當你進行這攀爬時，每移動1呎都會額外消耗你4呎的移動速度，而非原本的額外1呎移動速度。

entries.name: Survivor
entries: 你熟練於以下其中一個你所選擇的技能{@skill Animal Handling||動物馴養}、{@skill Medicine||醫藥}、{@skill Nature||自然}、或{@skill Survival||求生}。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和木族語。木族語因為有著豐富的詞彙去描述自然現象跟精神力量，而在瑟雷尼亞中被廣泛地使用。

items.name: Alignment
entries: Centaurs are inclined toward neutrality. Lagonna centaurs tend to be more lawful, while Pheres centaurs are more often chaotic.

items.name: Size
entries: Centaurs stand between 6 and 7 feet tall, with their equine bodies reaching about 4 feet at the withers. Pheres centaurs tend to be slightly larger than Lagonna centaurs. Your size is Medium.

items.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Fey.

entries.name: Charge
entries: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

entries.name: Equine Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag.

In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: You have hooves that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Natural Affinity
entries: Your fey connection to nature gives you an intuitive connection to the natural world and the animals within it. You therefore have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Changeling Instincts
entries: Thanks to your connection to the fey realm, you gain proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}.

entries.name: Shape-Shifter
entries: As an action, you can shape-shift to change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight and can change your size between Medium and Small. You can make yourself appear as a member of another playable species, though none of your game statistics change. You can't duplicate the appearance of an individual you've never seen, and you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs that you have. This trait doesn't change your clothing and equipment.
While shape-shifted with this trait, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.
You stay in the new form until you take an action to revert to your true form.

entries.name: Age
entries: Changelings mature slightly faster than humans but share a similar lifespan—typically a century or less. While a changeling can transform to conceal their age, the effects of aging affect them similarly to humans.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Changelings tend toward pragmatic neutrality, and few changelings embrace evil.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight, but not so much that your size changes. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your game statistics change. You can't duplicate the appearance of a creature you've never seen, and you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs that you have. Your clothing and equipment aren't changed by this trait.
You stay in the new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die.

entries.name: Changeling Instincts
entries: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, and {@skill Persuasion}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and two other languages of your choice.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Fey.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Changeling Instincts
entries: Thanks to your connection to the fey realm, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

Your clothing and equipment aren't changed by this trait.

race.name: Custom Lineage
entries: Instead of choosing one of the game's races for your character at 1st level, you can use the following traits to represent your character's lineage, giving you full control over how your character's origin shaped them:

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a humanoid. You determine your appearance and whether you resemble any of your kin.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Small or Medium (your choice).

entries.name: Feat
entries: You gain one {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

entries.name: Variable Trait
entries: You gain one of the following options of your choice: (a) {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet or (b) proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for your character.
Your race is considered to be a Custom Lineage for any game feature that requires a certain race, such as elf or dwarf.

items.name: Variable Trait; Darkvision
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Variable Trait; Skill Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a gnome for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a gnome.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Gift of the Svirfneblin
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell disguise self} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell nondetection} spell with it, without requiring a material component. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Gnomish Magic Resistance
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells.

entries.name: Svirfneblin Camouflage
entries: When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, you can make the check with advantage. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. When you reach character level 3, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Trace of Undeath
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Vampiric Bite
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can choose to bite with your fangs. You deal Piercing damage equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Constitution modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.
In addition, when you deal this damage to a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, you can empower yourself in one of the following ways:

items.name: Drain
entries: You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Piercing damage dealt.

items.name: Strengthen
entries: You gain a bonus to the next ability check or attack roll you make within the next minute; the bonus is equal to the Piercing damage dealt.

You can empower yourself with this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you gain this lineage.

entries.name: Ancestral Legacy
entries: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can keep the following elements of that race: any skill proficiencies you gained from it and any climbing, flying, or swimming speed you gained from it.
If you don't keep any of those elements or you choose this lineage at character creation, you gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness as shades of gray.

entries.name: Deathless Nature
entries: You don't need to breathe.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, at 3rd level, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Vampiric Bite
entries: Your fanged bite is a natural weapon, which counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. You add your Constitution modifier, instead of your Strength modifier, to the attack and damage rolls when you attack with this bite. It deals {@damage 1d4} piercing damage on a hit. While you are missing half or more of your hit points, you have advantage on attack rolls you make with this bite.
When you attack with this bite and hit a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, you can empower yourself in one of the following ways of your choice:

items: You regain hit points equal to the piercing damage dealt by the bite.
You gain a bonus to the next ability check or attack roll you make; the bonus equals the piercing damage dealt by the bite

entries: You can empower yourself with this bite a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: 年幼的龍裔成長速度很快。他們在孵化後幾個小時後就會步行，在3歲的時候就達到人類10歲孩童的體型和發育程度，並在15歲時成年。他們可以活到大約80歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 龍裔比人類更高更重，他們在站立時遠超過6呎高，且有著平均250磅的體重。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Draconic Ancestry
entries: 你擁有龍族的血統。從龍族血統表中選擇一個龍種。你的噴吐武器和傷害抗性將會由你所選的龍種而決定，如表所示。

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: 你可以使用你的動作以呼出毀滅性的能量。你的龍族血統決定了這個吐息的尺寸、形狀、以及傷害類型。
當你使用你的噴吐武器時，每個在吐息範圍內的生物都必須進行一次豁免檢定，其豁免屬行由你的龍族血統決定。這個豁免檢定的DC等同於8+你的體質調整值+你的熟練加值。一個豁免失敗的生物將受到{@dice 2d6}傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半的傷害。這個傷害將在你的等級升至6級時增加至{@dice 3d6}，11級時{@dice 4d6}，以及16級時{@dice 5d6}。
在你使用你的噴吐武器之後，直到完成一次短休或長休之前，你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: 你具有與你龍族血統相應傷害類型的抗性。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和龍語。龍語被認為是最古老的語言之一，且在魔法研究中經常被使用。龍語對大部分其他生物而言聽起來非常刺耳，而且包含了很多硬輔音和噝聲擦音。

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: 當你在自己的回合執行{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作時，你可以將其中一次攻擊替換為吐出魔法能量，形成 15 呎{@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|錐形}或長 30 呎、寬 5 呎的{@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|直線}（每次選擇形狀）。該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你的體質調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}）。豁免失敗時，生物受到 {@damage 1d10} 傷害，類型由你的龍族血統特性決定。豁免成功時，生物受到的傷害減半。此傷害在你達到角色等級 5（{@damage 2d10}）、11（{@damage 3d10}）與 17（{@damage 4d10}）時各增加 {@damage 1d10}。
你可以使用此吐息武器的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: 你對你的龍族血統特性所決定的傷害類型具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。

entries.name: Draconic Flight
entries: 當你達到角色等級 5 時，你可以引導龍族魔法讓自己暫時飛行。作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你的背上長出幽靈般的翅膀，持續 10 分鐘，或直到你收起翅膀（無需動作）或處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態為止。在此期間，你擁有等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}的{@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB|飛行速度}。你的翅膀看起來是由與你吐息武器相同的能量構成。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} or a 30-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} {{damageType}} damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when you reach character levels 5 ({@damage 2d10}), 11 ({@damage 3d10}), and 17 ({@damage 4d10}).
You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Speed
entries: 你的移動速度並不會因為穿著重甲而減少。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 習慣了地底的生活，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。 你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: 你在對抗毒素的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且你對毒素傷害具有抗性。

entries.name: Dwarven Combat Training
entries: 你熟練於{@item Battleaxe|phb|戰斧}、{@item Handaxe|phb|手斧}、{@item Light Hammer|phb|輕錘}、和{@item Warhammer|phb|戰錘}。

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: 你熟練於下列其中一個你所選擇的工匠工具：{@item Smith's Tools|phb|鐵匠工具}、{@item Brewer's Supplies|phb|釀酒師設備}、或{@item Mason's Tools|phb|石匠工具}。

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries: 每當你進行關聯於石製品起源的智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定時，你被視為熟練於{@skill History||歷史}技能，並將你二倍的熟練加值代替你原本的熟練加值加入該檢定中。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和矮人語。矮人語充斥了堅硬的輔音和喉音，而這些特徵也將顯露在任何矮人可能會說的其他語言中。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 中型（身高約 4–5 呎）

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有範圍 120 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: 你對毒素傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。你為避免或終止{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態所進行的豁免檢定也具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: 你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}上限提升 1，且每當你獲得一個等級時再提升 1。

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你獲得範圍 60 呎的{@sense Tremorsense|XPHB|震顫感知}，持續 10 分鐘。你必須位於石質表面上或碰觸石質表面，才能使用此{@sense Tremorsense|XPHB|震顫感知}。石頭可以是天然或經過加工的。
你可以使用此{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

entries.name: Age
entries: Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans, but they're considered young until they reach the age of 50. On average, they live about 350 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most dwarves are lawful, believing firmly in the benefits of a well-ordered society. They tend toward good as well, with a strong sense of fair play and a belief that everyone deserves to share in the benefits of a just order.

entries.name: Size
entries: Dwarves stand around 5 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 25 feet. Your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underground in your race's ancient past, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Artisan's Expertise
entries: You gain proficiency with two kinds of {@filter artisan's tools|items|source=phb|miscellaneous=mundane|type=artisan's tools} of your choice. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. In addition, whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) check related to the origin of any architectural construction (including buildings, public works such as canals and aqueducts, and the massive cogwork that underlies much of the construction of Ghirapur), you are considered proficient in the {@skill History} skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and {@language Dwarvish}. {@language Dwarvish} is full of hard consonants and guttural sounds, and those characteristics spill over into whatever other language a dwarf might speak.

race.name: Eladrin
entries: {@i Choose your eladrin's season: autumn, winter, spring, or summer. When finishing a long rest, you can change your season. See the "Info" tab for more information.}

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Fey Step
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

When you reach 3rd level, your Fey Step gain an additional effect based on your season; if the effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this race):

items.name: Autumn
items.entry: Immediately after you use your Fey Step, up to two creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for 1 minute, or until you or your companions deal any damage to the creatures.

items.name: Winter
items.entry: When you use your Fey Step, one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you before you teleport must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Spring
items.entry: When you use your Fey Step, you can touch one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature then teleports instead of you, appearing in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you.

items.name: Summer
items.entry: Immediately after you use your Fey Step, each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

Whenever you finish this trance, you can change your season, and you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a {@book weapon|phb|5|weapons} or a {@book tool|phb|5|tools} of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

items.name: Elven Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

entries.caption: Elven Lineages
rows: You know the {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=druid}.
The range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB} cantrip.

items.name: Elven Lineage (Lorwyn)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. You know the {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=druid}.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Command|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

items.name: Elven Lineage (Shadowmoor)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. The range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Heroism|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

entries.name: Hidden Step
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically turn {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
entries: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with Beasts, Plants, and vegetation. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

entries.name: Age
entries: 做為與精類有關的類人生物，費爾伯格有著悠長的壽命。一個費爾伯格在大約30歲左右成年，且他們之中最年長的可以活到500歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 費爾伯格的身高介於7到8呎，且體重介於240到300磅之間。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Firbolg Magic
entries: 你可以使用此特性施放{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}和{@spell Disguise Self||易容術}，使用睿知做為你施放它們的施法屬性。一旦你施放其中一個法術，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再施放它。當你使用這個版本的{@spell Disguise Self||易容術}時，你可以讓自己看起來比原本再矮3呎，使你更容易融入人類和精靈之中。

entries.name: Hidden Step
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以用魔法變得{@condition Invisible||隱形}直到你的下個回合開始，或直到你攻擊、擲傷害骰，或強迫某人進行一次豁免檢定。一旦你使用此特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳、推動、或提舉的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。

entries.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
entries: 你擁有與野獸和植物以有限方式進行溝通的能力。它們可以理解你話語的意思，然而你並沒有特殊能力以理解牠們的回覆。你在用於影響它們所進行的所有魅力檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語、精靈語、和巨人語。

items.name: Fire Resistance
entries: You have resistance to fire damage.

items.name: Reach to the Blaze
entries: You know the {@spell produce flame|XPHB} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell burning hands|XPHB} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell flame blade|XPHB} spell with this trait, without a material component. Once you cast {@spell burning hands|XPHB} or {@spell flame blade|XPHB} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Age
entries: 元素裔以和人類差不多的速度成熟，並在十多歲左右成人。他們活得比人類更久一點，最多到120歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 獨立而自信，元素裔傾向中立陣營。

entries.name: Size
entries: 元素裔的體型和他們的凡人父母一樣各有不同，但其體格通常與人類相似，直立身高從5呎到6呎以上。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語以及原初語。原初語是一種喉音語言，充滿短促的音節和生硬的輔音。

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Astral Spark
entries: Your psychic connection to the Astral Plane enables you to mystically access a spark of divine power, which you can channel through your weapons. When you hit a target with a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}, you can cause the target to take extra force damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, but you can use it no more than once per turn. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Firearms Mastery
entries: You have a mystical connection to firearms that traces back to the gods of the giff, who delighted in such weapons. You have proficiency with all firearms and ignore the {@itemProperty LD||loading} property of any firearm. In addition, attacking at long range with a firearm doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack roll.

entries.name: Hippo Build
entries: You have advantage on Strength-based ability checks and Strength saving throws. In addition, you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Age
entries: 吉斯人在近二十歲時成年，且可活約一個世紀。

entries.name: Size
entries: 吉斯人相較人類而言更高而纖瘦，身高大多為6呎。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和吉斯人語。

entries.name: Astral Knowledge
entries: You can mystically access a reservoir of experiences of entities connected to the Astral Plane. Whenever you finish a long rest, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice, selected from the Player's Handbook, as you momentarily project your consciousness into the Astral Plane. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

entries.name: Githyanki Psionics
entries: You know the {@spell mage hand} cantrip, and the hand is {@condition invisible} when you cast the cantrip with this trait.

Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell jump} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast {@spell misty step} with it. Once you cast {@spell jump} or {@spell misty step} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

entries.name: Psychic Resilience
entries: You have resistance to psychic damage.

entries.name: Githzerai Psionics
entries: You know the {@spell mage hand} cantrip, and the hand is {@condition invisible} when you cast the cantrip with this trait.

Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell shield} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell with it. Once you cast {@spell shield} or {@spell detect thoughts} spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

entries.name: Mental Discipline
entries: Your innate psychic defenses grant you advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions on yourself.

entries.name: Psychic Resilience
entries: You have resistance to psychic damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries: 你長滿獠牙的血盆大口是一種天生武器，且你可以用它來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它命中目標，則你造成等同1d4+你的力量調整值的穿刺傷害，而非一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Rampage
entries: 當你在你的回合以一次近戰攻擊將一個生物的生命值歸零，你可以採取一個附贈動作以移動最多等同於你移動速度一半的距離，並進行一次啃咬攻擊。

entries.name: Age
entries: 地侏的成熟速度和人類相同，且大部分會被預計在40歲左右安定下來進入成年的生活。他們可以活到350歲到接近500歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 地侏的身高範圍在3呎到4呎之間，且平均約40磅重。你的體型為小型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 習慣了地底的生活，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。 你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: 你在所有對抗魔法的智力、睿知、和魅力豁免中具有優勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和地侏語。地侏語是一種使用矮人文字的語言，並以其技術論文和對自然世界的知識分類而聞名。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 小型（身高約 3–4 呎）

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。

entries.name: Gnomish Cunning
entries: 你的智力、感知與魅力豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Gnomish Lineage
entries: 你屬於一個賦予你超自然能力的血系。從下列選項中擇一；無論選擇哪一個，智力、感知或魅力為你以此特性施展之法術的施法屬性（於選擇血系時決定）：

items.name: Forest Gnome
entries: 你知道{@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB|次級幻象}戲法。你也總是準備著{@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB|動物交談術}法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它，次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。你也可以使用你擁有的任何法術欄位施展該法術。

items.name: Rock Gnome
entries: 你知道{@spell Mending|XPHB|修復術}與{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB|魔法技倆}戲法。此外，你可以花費 10 分鐘施展{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB|魔法技倆}，製作一個微型發條裝置（AC 5，1 HP），例如玩具、點火器或音樂盒。製作裝置時，你從{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB|魔法技倆}中選擇一種效果來決定其功能；每當你或另一個生物執行一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}碰觸裝置以啟動它時，裝置便會產生該效果。若所選效果中有多種選項，你在製作裝置時為其選擇其中一種。例如，若你選擇該法術的點火／熄火效果，你要決定裝置是點火還是熄火，裝置不會兩者皆可。你同時最多可以擁有三個這樣的裝置，每個裝置會在製作後 8 小時，或你作為一個{@action Utilize|XPHB|運用}動作碰觸將其拆解時散架。

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Forest Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Rock Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Mending|XPHB} and {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it. For example, if you choose the spell's ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn't do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: 你天生就具備施放以下法術的能力，且無需任何材料構材：

items.name: At will:
items.entry: {@spell Nondetection||迴避偵測}(限定自身)

items.name: 1/day each:
items.entry: {@spell Blindness/Deafness||目盲/耳聾術}, {@spell Blur||朦朧術}, {@spell Disguise Self||易容術}

entries: 你施展這些法術的施法屬性為智力。

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: 習慣了地底的生活，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你120呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語、地侏語、土族語、和地底通用語。

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: 你可以在每次你的回合以一個附贈動作來採取{@action Disengage||撤離}或{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

items.name: Alignment
entries: In Eberron, goblins are usually neutral. They tend to look out for themselves, preferably without drawing unwanted attention from any larger, more powerful people.

items.name: Size
entries: Your size is Small.

items.name: Alignment
entries: Goblins are typically neutral evil, as they care only for their own needs. A few goblins might tend toward good or neutrality, but only rarely.

items.name: Age
entries: Goblins reach adulthood around age 8. They age noticeably faster than humans, and though few goblins live to old age, the most cautious rarely live longer than 60 years.

items.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin. In Ravnica, Goblin is a simplistic language with a limited vocabulary and fluid rules of grammar, unsuited for any sophisticated conversation.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were in dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Fury of the Small
entries: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.
You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

entries.name: Age
entries: Goblins mature faster than humans, reaching adulthood at around age 12. They also age noticeably faster than humans, and even the most cautious goblins rarely live longer than 50 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most goblins are wildly chaotic, though they have no particular inclination toward good or evil.

entries.name: Size
entries: Goblins average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

entries.name: Grit
entries: You have resistance to fire damage and psychic damage. In addition, when you are wearing no armor, your AC is equal to 11 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Age
entries: 哥布林大約在八歲左右成年，且可以活最多60年。

entries.name: Size
entries: 哥布林的身高介於3呎至4呎高，體重則介於40磅至80磅之間。你的體型為小型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Fury of the Small
entries: 當你以一次攻擊或法術傷害了一個體型比你大的生物時，你可以讓該攻擊或法術對該生物造成額外的傷害。這個額外傷害等同於你的等級。一旦你使用此特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: 你可以在每次你的回合以一個附贈動作來採取{@action Disengage||撤離}或{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和哥布林語。

items.name: Alignment
entries: Dankwood goblins are typically neutral or neutral good, though some mischievous Dankwood goblins are chaotic neutral.

items.name: Speak with Small Beasts
entries: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts. Dankwood goblins love animals and often keep squirrels, badgers, rabbits, moles, woodpeckers, and other creatures as beloved pets.

entries.name: Little Giant
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying weight and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Mountain Born
entries: You have resistance to cold damage. You also naturally acclimate to high altitudes, even if you've never been to one. This includes elevations above 20,000 feet.

entries.name: Stone's Endurance
entries: You can supernaturally draw on unyielding stone to shrug off harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a {@dice d12}. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.
You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: Goliaths have lifespans comparable to humans. They enter adulthood in their late teens and usually live less than a century.

entries.name: Size
entries: 歌利亞介於7到8呎高，且體重介於280到340磅。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Natural Athlete
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Athletics||運動}技能。

entries.name: Stone's Endurance
entries: 你可以透過專注自身以忽視重傷。當你受到傷害時，你可以使用你的反應以骰一顆{@dice 1d12}。將你的體質調整值加入骰出的數字，並將該傷害減少其總和的數值。在你使用此特性之後，直到完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳、推動、或提舉的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。

entries.name: Mountain Born
entries: 你已習慣於高海拔的環境，包括海拔高度20,000呎以上的環境。你也天生適應了寒冷的溫度，參見《地下城主指南》第五章的敘述。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和巨人語。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 中型（身高約 7–8 呎）

entries.name: Giant Ancestry
entries: 你是巨人的後裔。從下列益處中選擇一項——來自你血統的超自然恩賜；你可以使用所選益處的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的次數：

items.name: Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant)
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你以魔法傳送至多 30 呎，到達一處你能看見的未被佔據空間。

items.name: Fire's Burn (Fire Giant)
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個目標並對其造成傷害時，你也可以對該目標造成 {@damage 1d10} 火焰傷害。

items.name: Frost's Chill (Frost Giant)
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個目標並對其造成傷害時，你也可以對該目標造成 {@damage 1d6} 寒冷傷害，並使其{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}降低 10 呎，直到你的下個回合開始。

items.name: Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant)
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個大型或更小的生物並對其造成傷害時，你可以使該目標處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態。

items.name: Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant)
entries: 當你受到傷害時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}擲 {@dice 1d12}。將你的體質調整值加到擲骰結果上，並使傷害減少該總和。

items.name: Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant)
entries: 當你受到你 60 呎內一個生物的傷害時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，對該生物造成 {@damage 1d8} 雷鳴傷害。

entries.name: Large Form
entries: 從角色等級 5 開始，若你所在的空間夠大，你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}將你的體型變為大型。此變身持續 10 分鐘，或直到你結束它為止（無需動作）。在此期間，你的力量檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}，且你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}增加 10 呎。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 你為終止{@condition Grappled|XPHB|被擒}狀態而進行的任何屬性檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。在決定你的負重能力時，你也視為大一級的體型。

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Cloud)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Cloud's Jaunt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Fire)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Fire's Burn
entries: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal {@damage 1d10} Fire damage to that target.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Frost)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Frost's Chill
entries: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal {@damage 1d6} Cold damage to that target and reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Hill)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Hill's Tumble
entries: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Stone)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Stone's Endurance
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d12}. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Storm)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Storm's Thunder
entries: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage to that creature.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: 你沒有雙眼，且不會陷入{@condition Blinded||目盲}狀態。你可以察覺你周遭30呎範圍內的環境，或在{@condition Deafened||耳聾}時則為10呎範圍。你對超過這個半徑範圍外的事物被視作{@condition Blinded||目盲}。

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: 你在依賴聽覺和嗅覺的睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: 你在岩石地形為躲藏所進行的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫地底通用語。

entries.name: Age
entries: 格龍蛙人在一歲時成年，且已知可以活到最多50歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的格龍蛙人都是守序陣營，並在嚴格的種姓制度下長大。而由於他們那鮮少發生社會階級流動的文化，他們也通常是邪惡的。他們的社會階級流動大部分會發生在軍隊中，當某個種姓的成員死亡，且沒有其他成員能夠填補該空缺的時候。

entries.name: Size
entries: 格龍蛙人的身高介於2.5呎到3.5呎之間，且平均約30磅重。你的體型為小型。

entries.name: Arboreal Alertness
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Perception||感知}技能。

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: 你可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

entries.name: Poison Immunity
entries: 你免疫於毒素傷害和{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態。

entries.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: 任何擒抱你、或透過任何其他方式直接碰觸到你皮膚的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則將陷入{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態長達1分鐘。不再直接碰觸你皮膚的{@condition Poisoned||中毒}生物可以在它的每個回合結束時重複進行這個豁免檢定，豁免成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。
你也可以在使用任何穿刺武器進行攻擊時，做為其攻擊的一部份使用這個毒素，但這個毒素的效果將會因此產生變化。目標必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則將受到{@dice 2d4}的毒素傷害。

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries: 你的跳遠距離最多25呎、且跳高距離最多15呎，無論有沒有助跑都一樣。

entries.name: Water Dependency
entries: 若你在一天內沒有將自己浸泡在水中至少1小時，你將在該日結束時承受一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。你只能透過魔法或將你自己浸泡在水中至少1小時的方式來解除這個{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫格龍蛙人語。

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Dexterous Feet
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your feet to manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, or pick up or set down a Tiny object.

entries.name: Glide
entries: When you fall at least 10 feet above the ground, you can use your reaction to extend your skin membranes to glide horizontally a number of feet equal to your walking speed, and you take 0 damage from the fall. You determine the direction of the glide.

entries.name: Hadozee Dodge
entries: The magic that runs in your veins heightens your natural defenses. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a {@dice d6}. Add your proficiency bonus to the number rolled, and reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to that total (minimum of 0 damage).
You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: 半精靈的成熟速度和人類相同，並在20歲左右成年。然而，他們的壽命遠長於人類，經常能活超過180歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 半精靈有著和人類相近的體型，身高介於5呎至6呎之間。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 多虧於你的精靈血統，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: 你在對抗{@condition Charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且魔法無法讓你入睡。

entries.name: Skill Versatility
entries: 你熟練於二個你所選擇的技能。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語、精靈語、和另一種你所選擇的語言。

entries.name: Age
entries: 半獸人的成熟速度比人類略快一些，並在14歲左右便成年。他們的衰老速度明顯更快，且很少能活超過75歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 半獸人比人類更大而魁梧，他們的身高範圍從不到5呎到遠超過6呎都有。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 多虧於你的獸人血統，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Menacing
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}技能。

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: 當你的生命值被歸零但沒有當場被殺死時，你可以改為使生命值減少至1。直到完成一次長休之前，你都不能再使用這個特性。

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: 當你以一次近戰武器攻擊造成重擊時，你可以額外骰一次該武器的其中一顆傷害骰，並將之加入重擊的額外傷害中。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和獸人語。獸人語是一種使用硬輔音的粗糙、刺耳的語言。它沒有自己的文字，而是使用矮人文字進行書寫。

entries.name: Age
entries: 半身人在20歲時成年，且通常可以活到150歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 半身人平均大約3呎高，且體重約莫40磅。你的體型為小型。

entries.name: Lucky
entries: 當你在攻擊檢定、屬性檢定、或豁免檢定中骰出了1，你可以重骰該檢定且必須使用新的擲骰結果。

entries.name: Brave
entries: 你在對抗{@condition Frightened||恐懼}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: 你可以移動穿過任何體型大於你的生物所在的空間。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和半身人語。半身人的語言並不是秘密，但他們並不怎麼情願與他人分享它。他們很少書寫，因此並沒有豐富的文學作品。然而，他們的口說傳統相當強勢。幾乎所有半身人都會說通用語，以跟他所居住或旅經地區的人們交談。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 小型（身高約 2–3 呎）

entries.name: Brave
entries: 你為避免或終止{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態所進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: 你可以穿過任何比你大一級或更大之生物的空間，但你不能停留在同一個空間中。

entries.name: Luck
entries: 當你在{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 檢定}的 {@dice d20} 上擲出 1 時，你可以重擲該骰子，且必須使用新的結果。

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy
entries: 即使你只被一個比你至少大一級的生物遮蔽，你也可以執行{@action Hide|XPHB|躲藏}動作。

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Hare-Trigger
entries: You can add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls.

entries.name: Leporine Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Lucky Footwork
entries: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a {@dice d4} and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're {@condition prone} or your speed is 0.

entries.name: Rabbit Hop
entries: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Fey.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you gain this lineage.

entries.name: Ancestral Legacy
entries: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can keep the following elements of that race: any skill proficiencies you gained from it and any climbing, flying, or swimming speed you gained from it.
If you don't keep any of those elements or you choose this lineage at character creation, you gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness as shades of gray.

entries.name: Eerie Token
entries: As a bonus action, you can harmlessly remove a lock of your hair, one of your nails, or one of your teeth. This token is imbued with magic until you finish a long rest. While the token is imbued in this way, you can take these actions:

items.name: Telepathic Message
items.entry: As an action, you can send a telepathic message to the creature holding or carrying the token, as long as you are within 10 miles of it. The message can contain up to twenty-five words.

items.name: Remote Viewing
items.entry: If you are within 10 miles of the token, you can enter a trance as an action. The trance lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required) or are {@condition incapacitated}. During this trance, you can see and hear from the token as if you were located where it is. While you are using your senses at the token's location, you are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} in regard to your own surroundings. When the trance ends, the token is harmlessly destroyed.

entries: Once you create a token using this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, at which point your missing part regrows.

entries.name: Hex Magic
entries: You can cast the {@spell disguise self} and {@spell hex} spells with this trait. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose the ability when you gain this lineage).

entries.name: Becoming a Hag
entries: Hags can undertake a ritual to irreversibly transform a hexblood they created into a new hag, either one of their own kind or that embodies the hexblood's nature. This requires that both the hag and hexblood be in the same place and consent to the lengthy ritual—circumstances most hexbloods shun but might come to accept over the course of centuries. Once a hexblood undergoes this irreversible ritual, they emerge as a hag NPC no longer under the control of the hexblood's player, unless the DM rules otherwise.

entries.name: Martial Advantage
entries: 每回合一次，當你以一次武器攻擊命中一個生物時，若你有一個盟友距離該生物5呎內且該盟友並未{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，則你可以對它造成額外的{@dice 2d6}傷害。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和哥布林語。

items.name: Alignment
entries: Hobgoblin society in Eberron is shaped by the ideal of a strict code of honor and rigid martial discipline. Most hobgoblins are lawful, tending toward harsh enforcement of their laws.

items.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Fey Gift
entries: You can use this trait to take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action, and you can do so a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Starting at 3rd level, choose one of the options below each time you take the {@action Help} action with this trait:

items.name: Hospitality
items.entry: You and the creature you help each gain a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Passage
items.entry: You and the creature you help each increase your walking speeds by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Spite
items.entry: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the creature you help hits a target with an attack roll, that target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes within the next minute.

entries.name: Fortune from the Many
entries: If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can draw on your bonds of reciprocity to gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +3). You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: Hobgoblins mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.

entries.name: Size
entries: 大哥布林的身高介於5到6呎之間，且體重介於150到200磅。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Martial Training
entries: 你熟練於二種你所選擇的{@filter 軍用武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon}和輕甲。

entries.name: Saving Face
entries: 大哥布林由於懼怕失去地位，因此他們相當謹慎於不在盟友面前暴露軟弱。若你在一次攻擊檢定中失手，或在一次屬性檢定或豁免檢定中失敗，你可以讓該檢定獲得等同於距離你30呎內盟友數量的加值（最大加值+5）。一旦你使用此特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和哥布林語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Size
entries: 人類身高體格之間的差距很大，從勉強5呎高到遠超過6呎都有。不論你在這範圍內的位置為何，你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和另一種你所選擇的語言。人類通常會學習那些與他們打交道的其他族類的語言，包括那些晦澀難解的方言。他們喜歡借用來自其他方言的字詞去點綴他們的言詞，像是獸人的咒罵、精靈音樂般的措辭、矮人的軍事片語、諸如此類。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 中型（身高約 4–7 呎）或小型（身高約 2–4 呎），於選擇此種族時決定

entries.name: Resourceful
entries: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你獲得{@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB|英勇激勵}。

entries.name: Skillful
entries: 你獲得一項自選技能的熟練。

entries.name: Versatile
entries: 你獲得一個自選的{@filter 起源專長|feats|category=o}。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 人類並不傾向特定陣營。

entries: Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and the worst are found among them.

items.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common} and one extra language of your choice. Or, if your campaign uses the optional rules for languages found in the previous section, your national origin determines your native language: {@language Itzocan|PSX} for the Sun Empire, {@language Coalition pidgin|PSX} for the Brazen Coalition, or {@language Vampire|PSX} for the Legion of Dusk. You still speak one additional language of your choice, and {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} if it exists in your campaign.
