sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 6–7 feet tall)

entries.name: Dual Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Mental Discipline
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Mind Link
entries: You have telepathy with a range in feet equal to 10 times your level. When you're using this trait to speak telepathically to a creature, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to give that creature the ability to speak telepathically with you for 1 hour or until you take another {@action Magic|XPHB} action to end this effect.

entries.name: Severed from Dreams
entries: You can't be the target of the {@spell Dream|XPHB} spell. In addition, when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you finish another {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kalashtar mature and age at the same rate as humans.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The noble spirit tied to a kalashtar drives it toward lawful and good behavior. Most kalashtar combine strong self-discipline with compassion for all beings, but some kalashtar resist the virtuous influence of their spirit.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Dual Mind
entries: You have advantage on all Wisdom saving throws.

entries.name: Mental Discipline
entries: You have resistance to psychic damage.

entries.name: Mind Link
entries: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see, provided the creature is within a number of feet of you equal to 10 times your level. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

When you're using this trait to speak telepathically to a creature, you can use your action to give that creature the ability to speak telepathically with you for 1 hour or until you end this effect as an action. To use this ability, the creature must be able to see you and must be within this trait's range. You can give this ability to only one creature at a time; giving it to a creature takes it away from another creature who has it.

entries.name: Severed from Dreams
entries: Kalashtar sleep, but they don't connect to the plane of dreams as other creatures do. Instead, their minds draw from the memories of their otherworldly spirit while they sleep. As such, you are immune to spells and other magical effects that require you to dream, like {@spell dream}, but not to spells and other magical effects that put you to sleep, like {@spell sleep}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Quori, and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: Fearless
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on yourself. When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on yourself, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you succeed on a saving throw in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Kender Curiosity
entries: Thanks to the mystical origin of your people, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Sleight of Hand}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Taunt
entries: You have an extraordinary ability to fluster creatures. As a bonus action, you can unleash a string of provoking words at a creature within 60 feet of yourself that can hear and understand you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the start of your next turn. The DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this race).
You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Ambusher
entries: 在戰鬥的第一輪中，你對任何被突襲的生物所進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: 你可以模仿任何你曾聽過的聲音，包括人的嗓音。一個聽到這類聲音的生物可以透過成功通過一次睿知（{@skill Insight||察言觀色}）檢定來對抗你的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定以辨別出它是被模仿發出的。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和氣族語，但你只能使用你的擬聲特性來說話。

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Expert Duplication
entries: When you copy writing or craftwork produced by yourself or someone else, you have advantage on any ability checks you make to produce an exact duplicate.

entries.name: Kenku Recall
entries: Thanks to your supernaturally good memory, you have proficiency in two skills of your choice.

Moreover, when you make an ability check using any skill in which you have proficiency, you can give yourself advantage on the check before rolling the {@dice d20}. You can give yourself advantage in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: You can accurately mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations only with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Age
entries: 天狗有著比人類更短的壽命。他們在12歲左右成年，且可以活到60歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 天狗的身高大約為5呎高，且體重介於90到120磅之間。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Expert Forgery
entries: 你可以複製其他生物的筆跡和手藝。你在用於偽造文書或複製既存物體所進行的所有檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Kenku Training
entries: 你熟練於下列二個你所選擇的技能：{@skill Acrobatics||特技}、{@skill Deception||欺瞞}、{@skill Stealth||隱匿}、和{@skill Sleight of Hand||手上把戲}。

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: 你可以模仿任何你曾聽過的聲音，包括人的嗓音。一個聽到這類聲音的生物可以透過成功通過一次睿知（{@skill Insight||察言觀色}）檢定來對抗你的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定以辨別出它是被模仿發出的。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和氣族語，但你只能使用你的擬聲特性來說話。

entries.name: Age
entries: 胡狼人成熟速度很快，在十幾歲便成年。胡狼人祀徒通常會是同輩中最年輕的一群，並會在他們近二十歲時完成祀煉。即使沒有因暴力而死亡，他們也很少活過60歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的胡狼人傾向混亂陣營。他們並不特別傾向善良或邪惡。

entries.name: Size
entries: 胡狼人有著和人類相似的身形。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Khenra Weapon Training
entries: 你熟練於埃及鐮狀劍({@item Longsword|phb|長劍})、{@item Spear|phb|矛}、和{@item Javelin|phb|標槍}。

entries.name: Khenra Twins
entries: 若你的雙胞胎仍活著，且你可以看見你的雙胞胎，則每當你在一次攻擊檢定、屬性檢定、或豁免檢定中骰出1時，你都可以重擲該骰且必須使用新的擲骰結果。若你的雙胞胎已經死亡（或若你出生時並沒有雙胞胎），則你將不會被{@condition Frightened||恐懼}。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和胡狼人語。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-6 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Fey Gift
entries: You know the {@spell Friends|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose the ability when you select this species).

entries.name: Lethargy Resilience
entries: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, you can succeed instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|Long Rests}.

entries.name: Skill Versatility
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill or with one tool of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace it with another skill or tool proficiency.

items.name: Kithkin Lineage
entries: As a native of either Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, you may gain additional traits.

items.name: Lorwyn
entries: You do not gain any additional traits.

items.name: Shadowmoor
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

items.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: 若你有至少一個盟友距離目標生物5呎內且該盟友並未{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，則你在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當你、你的攻擊目標、或你嘗試感知的東西直接暴露在陽光下，則你依賴於視覺的攻擊檢定以及睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定具有劣勢。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were in dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Draconic Cry
entries: As a bonus action, you let out a cry at your enemies within 10 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, you and your allies have advantage on attack rolls against any of those enemies who could hear you. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Kobold Legacy
entries: Kobold's connections to dragons can manifest in unpredictable ways in an individual kobold. Choose one of the following legacy options for your kobold.

items.name: Craftiness
items.entry: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Sleight of Hand}, or {@skill Survival}.

items.name: Defiance
items.entry: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on yourself.

items.name: Draconic Sorcery
items.entry: You know one {@filter cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=0|class=Sorcerer}. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for that cantrip (choose when you select this race).

items.name: Kobold Legacy (Craftiness)
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Sleight of Hand}, or {@skill Survival}.

items.name: Kobold Legacy (Defiance)
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on yourself.

items.name: Kobold Legacy (Draconic Sorcery)
entries: You know one {@filter cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=0|class=Sorcerer}. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for that cantrip (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Age
entries: 狗頭人在6歲時成年，並可以活到最多120歲，但這相當罕見。

entries.name: Size
entries: 狗頭人的身高介於2到3呎，且體重介於25到35磅。你的體型為小型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: 在你的回合以一個動作，你可以可憐兮兮地蜷縮以分散附近敵人的注意。直到你下個回合結束前，你的盟友在對距離你10呎內且你能看見的敵人所進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。一旦你使用這個特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都無法再使用它。

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: 若你有至少一個盟友距離目標生物5呎內且該盟友並未{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，則你在對該生物進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當你、你的攻擊目標、或你嘗試感知的東西直接暴露在陽光下，則你依賴於視覺的攻擊檢定以及睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定具有劣勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和龍語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Kor mature at the same rate as humans and live about as long.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most kor are lawful good, with a strong dedication to community and the traditions of their ancestors.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kor average nearly 6 feet tall, but are much lighter and more slender than humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Brave
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

entries.name: Climbing
entries: You also have a climbing speed of 30 feet as long as you are not encumbered or wearing heavy armor.

entries.name: Kor Climbing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} and {@skill Acrobatics} skills.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, and communicate in the silent speech of the Kor.

entries.name: Lucky
entries: When you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: 你可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

entries.name: Otherworldly Perception
entries: 你可以感知到任何距離你30呎內處於{@condition Invisible||隱形}狀態或在乙太位面的生物。你可以準確知道這類生物在移動時的確切位置。

entries.name: Slippery
entries: 你在為逃離擒抱所進行的屬性檢定和豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當處於日光照耀下時，你在攻擊檢定，以及依賴視覺的睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中具有劣勢。

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: 你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你120呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫地底通用語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Leonin mature and age at about the same rate as humans.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Leonin tend toward good alignments. Leonin who are focused on the pride lean toward lawful good.

entries.name: Size
entries: Leonin are typically over 6 feet tall, with some standing over 7 feet. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you can deal slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Hunter's Instincts
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Perception}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Daunting Roar
entries: As a bonus action, you can let out an especially menacing roar. Creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. The DC of the save equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Leonin.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: 你可以屏住你的呼吸長達15分鐘。

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: 你的鱗片做為天生護甲發揮作用，讓你的護甲等級獲得+3加值。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫龍語。

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Bite
entries: You have a fanged maw that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

entries.name: Hungry Jaws
entries: You can throw yourself into a feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your Bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Nature's Intuition
entries: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Age
entries: 蜥蜴人在大約14歲時成年，且很少活超過60年。

entries.name: Size
entries: Lizardfolk are a little bulkier and taller than humans, and their colorful frills make them appear even larger. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Swim Speed
entries: 你擁有30呎的游泳速度。

entries.name: Bite
entries: 你長滿獠牙的血盆大口是一種天生武器，且你可以用它來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它命中目標，則你造成等同1d6+你的力量調整值的穿刺傷害，而非一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Cunning Artisan
entries: 做為短休的一部分，你可以利用從被殺死的小型或更大的野獸、構裝體、龍、怪獸，或植物身上採集下來的骨頭和獸皮製作下列其中一個物品：一面{@item Shield|phb|盾牌}、一根{@item Club|phb|棍棒}、一把{@item Javelin|phb|標槍}、或{@dice 1d4}個{@item Dart|phb|飛鏢}或{@item Blowgun Needle|phb|吹箭}。若要使用這個特性，你將需要一把刀刃，像是一把{@item Dagger|phb|匕首}、或是其他適合的工匠工具，例如{@item Leatherworker's Tools|phb|皮匠工具}。

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: 你可以屏住你的呼吸長達15分鐘。

entries.name: Hunter's Lore
entries: 你熟練於下列二種你所選擇的技能：{@skill Animal Handling||動物馴養}、{@skill Nature||自然}、{@skill Perception||感知}、{@skill Stealth||隱匿}、和{@skill Survival||求生}。

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: 你擁有堅硬、帶鱗的皮膚。當你未穿戴護甲時，你的AC為13+你的敏捷調整值。如果你穿著的護甲會讓你有較低的AC，則你可以使用你的天生護甲來計算你的AC。當你使用天生護甲時，盾牌的加值仍會如常作用。

entries.name: Hungry Jaws
entries: 在戰鬥中，你可以讓你自己陷入一種兇猛的暴食狂熱。以一個附贈動作，你可以使用你的啃咬進行一次特殊攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則它將造成它原本的傷害，且你獲得等同於你體質調整值（最低為1）的臨時生命值，且直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用此特性。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和龍語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Locathah mature to adulthood by the age of 10 but have been known to live up to 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most locathah are true neutral or have some aspect of neutrality in their alignment. They tend toward good, coming from a culture where compassion for the downtrodden is a commonality.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Observant & Athletic
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} and {@skill Perception} skills.

entries.name: Leviathan Will
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, {@condition stunned}, or put to sleep.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: You can breathe air and water, but you need to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Size
entries: Locathah stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Language
entries: You can speak, read, and write Aquan and Common.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Shape Self
entries: As an action, you can reshape your body to a two-legged Humanoid shape or to a four-legged Beast shape. While you have a Humanoid shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Delightful Imitator
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Deception|XPHB} or {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Unpredictable Movement
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can immediately move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, provided you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll.

entries.name: Age
entries: 象族生理成年的速度與人類相同，但他們的壽命可達大約450歲。他們非常重視智慧與經驗的重要性，且在達到60歲之前都被視為年輕人。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大多數的象族都是守序的，相信著和平與秩序生活的價值。他們也傾向善良。

entries.name: Size
entries: 象族的身高介於7呎至8呎之間。他們龐大身軀的重量則介於300至400磅之間。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳、推動、或提舉的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。

entries.name: Loxodon Serenity
entries: 你在對抗{@condition Charmed||魅惑}或{@condition Frightened||恐懼}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: 你有著厚實、皮革般的肌膚。當你未穿著護甲的時候，你的AC為12+你的體質調整值。如果你穿著的護甲會讓你有較低的AC，則你可以使用你的天生護甲來計算你的AC。當你使用天生護甲時，盾牌的加值仍會如常作用。

entries.name: Tip: AC Calculations Don't Stack
entries: 當遊戲機制給了你多於一種計算護甲等級的方式，你只能使用其中一種方式。由你選擇要使用哪一種。舉例來說，如果你同時擁有象族的天生護甲和武僧的無甲防禦，你不能把它們混在一起使用。你只能選擇其中一種方式來計算你的AC。
entries.name_zh: 提示：AC的計算方法並不會累積

entries.name: Trunk
entries: 你可以用你的象鼻抓取物品，你也可以把它作為呼吸管使用。它有著5呎觸及範圍，且它可以抬起等同你力量屬性值五倍的磅數。你可以用它做出以下的簡單作業：抬起、丟下、持握、推動或是拖動一個物體或生物；打開或關上一扇門或容器；擒抱某人；或進行一次徒手打擊。你的DM可能會允許你將其他的簡單作業加到上面的選項列表中。
你的象鼻不能使用武器、盾牌、或其他需要精細操作的東西，像是使用工具或魔法物品、或執行一個法術的姿勢構材。

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: 多虧了你那敏銳的象鼻，你在牽涉到嗅覺的睿知({@skill Perception||感知})、睿知({@skill Survival||求生})、和智力({@skill Investigation||調查})檢定上具有優勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和象族語。

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: 你可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和水族語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Merfolk mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live considerably longer than humans, though, often reaching well over 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most merfolk are neutral, though merfolk of the Emeria and Cosi creeds have chaotic leanings.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Size
entries: Merfolk are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Swimming
entries: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Merfolk, and one extra language of your choice.
{@note These traits are also suitable for minotaurs in other D&D worlds where these people have avoided the demonic influence of Baphomet.}

entries.name: Age
entries: 牛頭怪在17歲左右成年，且有最多150年的壽命。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分加入波洛斯的牛頭人傾向守序陣營，而那些與拉鐸司和古魯有關的牛頭人則傾向混亂陣營。

entries.name: Size
entries: 牛頭怪的平均身高超過6呎，且他們有著健壯的身材。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Horns
entries: 你的牛角是天生近戰武器，你可以使用它們來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它們命中目標，則你造成等同1d6+你的力量調整值的穿刺傷害，而不是一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Goring Rush
entries: 緊接在你於你的回合使用{@action Dash||疾走}動作並移動至少20呎後，你可以立刻以一個附贈動作使用你的牛角進行一次近戰攻擊。

entries.name: Hammering Horns
entries: 緊接在你於你的回合以{@action Attack||攻擊}動作的一部分，透過一次近戰攻擊命中一個生物後，你可以立刻以一個附贈動作嘗試使用你的牛角去推撞該目標。目標的體型不能比你大超過一級，且必須距離你5呎以內。除非它成功通過DC等同於8+你的熟練加值+你的力量調整值的力量豁免，否則你將把它推離你最多10呎。

entries.name: Imposing Presence
entries: 你熟練於以下其中一個你所選擇的技能：{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和牛頭語。

items.name: Age
entries: Minotaurs mature and age at about the same rate as humans.

items.name: Alignment
entries: Minotaurs who leave the walls of Skophos have the opportunity to be free of its culture and pursue chaotic alignments, while those who remain within the polis and its tyrannical regime tend toward lawful alignments.

entries.name: Horns
entries: You have horns that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Goring Rush
entries: Immediately after you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your Horns as a bonus action.

entries.name: Hammering Horns
entries: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to push that target with your horns. The target must be within 5 feet of you and no more than one size larger than you. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier, you can push it up to 10 feet away from you.

entries.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: You always know which direction is north, and you have advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check you make to navigate or track.

entries.name: Age
entries: 牛頭人的發育比人類緩慢，在20歲左右才會完全成熟。他們通常會在8到9歲時做為侍僧，加入他們同儕間較年長的成員。然而，一旦他們成年，牛頭人將會迅速的衰老。他們也會因此積極投入祀煉之旅（他們在生命中其他方面的表現也是如此），以在他們從巔峰衰弱之前完成祀煉。能夠死於高齡的牛頭怪也鮮少活超過40歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的牛頭人傾向混亂陣營，且他們有著些微朝向邪惡的傾向。

entries.name: Size
entries: 牛頭怪的平均身高超過6呎，且他們有著健壯的身材。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Natural Weapon
entries: 你可以使用你的雙角做為天生武器來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它們命中目標，則你造成等同1d6+你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Menacing
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}技能。

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: 當你的生命值被歸零但沒有當場被殺死時，你可以改為使生命值減少至1。直到完成一次長休之前，你都不能再使用這個特性。

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: 當你以一次近戰武器攻擊造成重擊時，你可以額外骰一次該武器的其中一顆傷害骰，並將之加入重擊的額外傷害中。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和牛頭語。

entries.name: Age
entries: 與人類相似，納迦在近二十歲時成年。他們在長到一定年紀後，除了越長越大之外便不會再有其他衰老的跡象，因此理論上，一名納迦可以活到超過一個世紀。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分納迦的陣營屬於絕對中立或中立邪惡。

entries.name: Size
entries: 納迦在直立時約莫5呎高，但他們身體從頭到尾的總長可以從10呎到20呎不等。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Speed Burst
entries: 透過將你的身體壓低在地，並用雙手推動自己，你可以在一段時間內移動得比平常更快。在你的回合以一個附贈動作，若你有兩隻空手，則你可以使你的步行速度增加5呎，持續直到你的回合結束。

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: 你的尖牙和絞纏的蛇形身體都是天生武器，且你可以用它們來進行徒手打擊。
如果你使用啃咬攻擊並命中目標，則你造成等同1d4+你的力量調整值的穿刺傷害，且你的目標必須進行一次體質豁免（DC 8+你的熟練加值+你的體質調整值）。若豁免失敗，目標將受到1d4毒素傷害。
如果你使用絞纏攻擊並命中目標，則你造成等同1d6+你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害，且目標{@condition Grappled||被擒}（逃脫DC 8+你的熟練加值+你的力量調整值）。直到擒抱結束前，目標被{@condition Restrained||束縛}，且你不能絞纏另一個目標。

entries.name: Poison Immunity
entries: 你免疫於毒素傷害和{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態。

entries.name: Poison Affinity
entries: 你熟練於{@item Poisoner's Kit|phb|製毒工具組}。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和納迦語。

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward a hostile creature that you can see.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc.

items.name: Age
entries: Orcs reach adulthood at age 16, and live up to 80 years.

items.name: Alignment
entries: Orcs fear the curse of ruin that is said to plague their race, and tend strongly toward either chaos (accepting their fate), or toward law (rejecting it).

items.name: Size
entries: Orcs stand easily 8 feet tall and corded with powerful muscles, weighing up to 280 pounds. Your size is Medium.

items.name: Primal Intuition
entries: You have proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Perception}, and {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Age
entries: Orcs reach adulthood at age 12 and live up to 50 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The orcs of Eberron are a passionate people, given to powerful emotion and deep faith. They are generally chaotic, but can be any alignment.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, you can move up to your movement speed toward a hostile creature you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Primal Intuition
entries: You have proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Perception}, and {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc.

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: You can take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Whenever you use this trait, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: 獸人在12歲時成年，並可以活到最多50歲。

entries.name: Size
entries: 獸人通常超過6呎高，且體重介於230到280磅之間。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。 你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以向一個你所能看見或聽見的敵意生物移動最多等同你移動速度的距離。你必須在比你開始移動時距離該敵人更近的位置結束此移動。

entries.name: Primal Intuition
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}技能。

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: 當決定你的負重以及你可以拖曳、推動、或提舉的重量時，你將你的體型視作比原本大一級。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和獸人語。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 中型（身高約 6–7 呎）

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: 你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}執行{@action Dash|XPHB|疾走}動作。當你這麼做時，你獲得等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|臨時生命值}。
你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有範圍 120 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: 當你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}降至 0 但未被直接殺死時，你可以改為降至 1 點{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用。

entries.name: Age
entries: Orcs mature a little faster than humans, reaching adulthood around age 14. They age noticeably faster and rarely live longer than 75 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most orcs lean toward chaotic alignments, and many serve on pirate ships that encourage an inclination toward evil.

entries.name: Size
entries: Orcs average over 6 feet in height, and they have strong, stocky builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation} skill.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (if it exists in your campaign) and {@language Orc|PHB}.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of yourself as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Flight
entries: Thanks to your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

entries.name: Silent Feathers
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} skill.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are an Ooze.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided you are wearing and carrying nothing. You have advantage on ability checks you make to initiate or escape a grapple.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of yourself as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: You can hold your breath for 1 hour.

entries.name: Natural Resilience
entries: You have resistance to acid and poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

entries.name: Shape Self
entries: As an action, you can reshape your body to give yourself a head, one or two arms, one or two legs, and makeshift hands and feet, or you can revert to a limbless blob. While you have a humanlike shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

As a bonus action, you can extrude a pseudopod that is up to 6 inches wide and 10 feet long or reabsorb it into your body. As part of the same bonus action, you can use this pseudopod to manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, or pick up or set down a Tiny object. The pseudopod contains no sensory organs and can't attack, activate magic items, or lift more than 10 pounds.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you gain this lineage.

entries.name: Ancestral Legacy
entries: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can keep the following elements of that race: any skill proficiencies you gained from it and any climbing, flying, or swimming speed you gained from it.
If you don't keep any of those elements or you choose this lineage at character creation, you gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

entries.name: Deathless Nature
entries: You have escaped death, a fact represented by the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against disease and being {@condition poisoned}, and you have resistance to poison damage.
You have advantage on death saving throws.
You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.
You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

entries.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
entries: You temporarily remember glimpses of the past, perhaps faded memories from ages ago or a previous life. When you make an ability check that uses a skill, you can roll a {@dice d6} immediately after seeing the number on the {@dice d20} and add the number on the {@dice d6} to the check. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Cold Fire Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrip. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn the {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB} spell and the {@spell Flame Blade|XPHB} spell, respectively. You always have those spells prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast these spells in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you cast {@spell Flame Blade|XPHB} using this trait, the spell deals Cold damage instead of Fire damage.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose the ability when you select this species).

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Age
entries: Satyrs mature and age at about the same rate as humans.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Satyrs delight in living a life free of the mantle of law. They gravitate toward being good, but some have devious streaks and enjoy causing dismay.

entries.name: Size
entries: Satyrs range from just under 5 feet to about 6 feet in height, with generally slender builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Fey
entries: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

entries.name: Ram
entries: You can use your head and horns to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Mirthful Leaps
entries: Whenever you make a long or high jump, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

entries.name: Reveler
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Performance} and {@skill Persuasion} skills, and you have proficiency with one {@item musical instrument|PHB} of your choice.

entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

entries.name: Mirthful Leaps
entries: Whenever you make a long jump or a high jump, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as usual.

entries.name: Reveler
entries: As an embodiment of revelry, you have proficiency in the {@skill Performance} and {@skill Persuasion} skills, and you have proficiency with one {@item musical instrument|PHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Child of the Sea
entries: You can breathe air and water, and you have resistance to cold damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Friend of the Sea
entries: Aquatic animals have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a {@book weapon|phb|5|weapons} or a {@book tool|phb|5|tools} of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

entries.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

entries.name: Bestial Instincts
entries: Channeling the beast within, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Athletics|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Shifting
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can shape-shift to assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you revert to your normal appearance as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you shift, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 2 times your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can shift a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
Whenever you shift, you gain the benefit of one of the following options (choose when you select this species)

items.name: Beasthide
entries: You gain {@dice 1d6} additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While shifted, you have a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

items.name: Longtooth
entries: When you shift and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your other turns while shifted, you can use your elongated fangs to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. entries: Shifters are quick to mature both physically and emotionally, reaching young adulthood at age 10. They rarely live to be more than 70 years old.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Shifters tend toward neutrality, being more focused on survival than concepts of good and evil. A love of personal freedom can drive shifters toward chaotic alignments.

entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed

entries.name: Darkvision

entries.name: Age
entries: 混合體一出生就是個成年的人類、精靈、或維多肯。他們已稍快的速度老化，因此他們的最大壽命可能會有所減少。守護者計畫執行的時間長度尚不足以觀察這個現象對混合體的整體影響。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的混合體都跟析米克聯合有著相同的中立觀點。他們對科學研究和公會地位的興致遠高於道德倫理問題。然而，那些離開聯合的混合體通常是因為他們的哲學觀與其他公會更為一致。

entries.name: Size
entries: 你的體型為中型，你的身高體重都落在作為你基底的類人種族的正常範圍內。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和精靈語或維多肯語。

entries.name: Animal Enhancement
entries: 你的身體已經被改造成包含某些動物的特徵。你在現在選擇一項動物改造，並在到達5級時選擇第二項。
在1級時，從下列選項中選擇一項：

items.name: Manta Glide
items.entry: 你擁有如鰩類般的魚鰭，讓你可以將它們作為翅膀以減緩墜落速度或讓你得以滑翔。當你墜落且並未{@condition Incapacitated||無力}時，你可以在計算墜落傷害時減去100呎的墜落高度，且每下降1呎，都可以讓你水平移動最多2呎。

items.name: Nimble Climber
items.entry: 你擁有等同於你步行速度的攀爬速度。

items.name: Underwater Adaptation
items.entry: 你可以在水下呼吸，且你擁有等同於你步行速度的游泳速度。

entries: 在5級時，你的身體進一步進化，發展出新的特徵。選擇一項你在1級時沒有選擇的選項，或從下列選項中選擇一項：

items.name: Grappling Appendage
items.entry: 在你的雙臂旁長出了兩個特殊的附肢。決定它們是爪子還是觸手。以一個動作，你可以使用它們其中之一去嘗試擒抱一個生物。它們兩個都是天生武器，你可以使用它們來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它命中目標，目標將受到等同1d6+你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害，而不是一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。緊接在命中之後，你可以嘗試以一個附贈動作對目標進行擒抱。這些附肢不能精準的操作任何東西，也不能使用武器、魔法物品、或其它專門的裝備。

items.name: Carapace
items.entry: 你的肌膚各處覆蓋著厚重的甲殼。當你沒有穿著重甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

items.name: Acid Spit
items.entry: 以一個動作，你可以從你嘴裡的腺體對一個距離你30呎內且你所能看見的生物或物體噴出酸液。除非目標成功通過一次DC等同於8+你的體質調整值+你的熟練加值的敏捷豁免，否則它將受到{@dice 2D10}酸蝕傷害。這個傷害將在你的等級升至11級時增加至{@dice 3d10}，17級時{@dice 4d10}。你可以使用這項特性的次數等同於你的體質調整值(最少一次)，且你在完成一次長休後恢復所有已使用的次數。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 大部分的賽壬傾向混亂陣營，珍惜著因加入海盜團而帶來的自由與獨立。

entries.name: Size
entries: 賽壬的身高約為5到6呎，但他們的身軀相當纖細，骨頭部分中空以利飛行。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Siren's Song
entries: 你知曉{@spell Friends||交友術}戲法，且施放時無需任何材料構材。

entries.name: Flight
entries: 你擁有30呎的飛行速度。你不能在穿著中甲或重甲時使用你的飛行速度。（如果你的戰役使用了負重的變體規則，則你不能在你負載時使用你的飛行速度。）

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語（若存在於你的戰役）和賽壬語。

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are Undead.

entries.name: Brittle Bones
entries: You are vulnerable to bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: 你免疫於毒素傷害和{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，且你不會陷入{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態。你不再需要呼吸、進食、飲水、或睡眠。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你無法說話，但你可以理解任何你生前所知的語言。

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Cat's Claws
entries: You can use your claws to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Cat's Talent
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Stealth} skills.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Feline Agility
entries: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

entries.name: Age
entries: Tabaxi have lifespans equivalent to humans.

entries.name: Size
entries: Tabaxi are taller on average than humans and relatively slender. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有貓的敏銳感官，特別是在黑暗中。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Feline Agility
entries: 你的反射神經和敏捷性讓你能夠以爆發性的速度移動。當你在戰鬥中於你的回合移動時，你可以將你的移動速度變為二倍，持續直到該回合結束。一旦你使用此特性，直到你在你的其中一個回合移動0呎之前，你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Cat's Claws
entries: 由於你的利爪，你擁有20呎的攀爬速度。此外，你的利爪是一種天生武器，且你可以用它來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它們命中目標，則你造成等同1d4+你的力量調整值的劈砍傷害，而非一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Cat's Talents
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Perception||感知}和{@skill Stealth||隱匿}技能。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和另一種你所選擇的語言。

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Monstrosity.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Chameleon Carapace
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, your carapace gives you a base Armor Class of 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

As an action, you can change the color of your carapace to match the color and texture of your surroundings, giving you advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to {@action hide} in those surroundings.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of yourself as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Secondary Arms
entries: You have two slightly smaller secondary arms below your primary pair of arms. The secondary arms can manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, pick up or set down a Tiny object, or wield a weapon that has the {@itemProperty L||light} property.

entries.name: Sleepless
entries: You do not require sleep and can remain conscious during a long rest, though you must still refrain from strenuous activity to gain the benefit of the rest.

entries.name: Thri-kreen Telepathy
entries: Without the assistance of magic, you can't speak the non-thri-kreen languages you know. Instead you use telepathy to convey your thoughts. You have the magical ability to transmit your thoughts mentally to willing creatures within 120 feet of yourself. A contacted creature doesn't need to share a language with you to understand your thoughts, but it must be able to understand at least one language. Your telepathic link to a creature is broken if you and the creature move more than 120 feet apart, if either of you is {@condition incapacitated}, or if either of you mentally breaks the contact (no action required).

entries.name: Age
entries: 提夫林的成熟速度和人類相同，但可以比人類多活個幾年。

entries.name: Size
entries: 提夫林也許並沒有傾向邪惡的天性，但他們之中許多最終都步向邪惡。無論邪惡與否，他們獨立的天性使許多提夫林都偏向了混亂陣營。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 提夫林的身材和體型與人類大致相同。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Hellish Resistance
entries: 多虧於你的煉獄血脈，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Infernal Legacy
entries: 你具有對火焰傷害的抗性。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語和煉獄語。

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: 中型（身高約 4–7 呎）或小型（身高約 3–4 呎），於選擇此種族時決定

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。

entries.name: Fiendish Legacy
entries: 你繼承了一份賦予你超自然能力的傳承。從「邪魔傳承」表中選擇一個傳承。你獲得所選傳承的 1 級益處。
當你達到角色等級 3 與 5 時，你學會一道更高環的法術，如表中所示。你總是準備著該法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它一次，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復以此方式施展它的能力。你也可以使用你擁有的適當環階法術欄位施展該法術。智力、感知或魅力為你以此特性施展之法術的施法屬性（於選擇傳承時決定）。

entries.caption: 邪魔傳承
rows: 你對毒素傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。你也知道{@spell Poison Spray|XPHB|毒氣噴灑}戲法。
你對黯蝕傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。你也知道{@spell Chill Touch|XPHB|寒顫之觸}戲法。
你對火焰傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。你也知道{@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB|火焰箭}戲法。

entries.name: Otherworldly Presence
entries: 你知道{@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB|奇術}戲法。當你以此特性施展它時，該法術使用與你的邪魔傳承特性相同的施法屬性。

items.name: Fiendish Legacy (Abyssal)
entries: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also know the {@spell Poison Spray|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Ray of Sickness|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Hold Person|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the legacy).

items.name: Fiendish Legacy (Chthonic)
entries: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. You also know the {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell False Life|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Ray of Enfeeblement|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the legacy).

items.name: Fiendish Legacy (Infernal)
entries: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. You also know the {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the legacy).

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have claws that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Your shell provides you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can't wear light, medium, or heavy armor, but if you are using a shield, you can apply the shield's bonus as normal.

entries.name: Nature's Intuition
entries: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Shell Defense
entries: You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in your shell, you are {@condition prone}, your speed is 0 and can't increase, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, you can't take reactions, and the only action you can take is a bonus action to emerge from your shell.

entries.name: Age
entries: 年輕的龜人在出生後學會雙腳行走前，會爬行移動持續數週的時間。他們會在15歲成年，且平均可以活50年。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 龜人傾向過著有序、儀式化的生活。他們發展許多風俗和慣例，並且隨著年歲增長變得因循守舊。他們大部分是守序善良。少部分會自私貪婪，並更傾向邪惡陣營，但擺脫守序而偏愛混亂對於龜人而言相當不尋常。

entries.name: Size
entries: 成年龜人的身高為5到6呎高且平均450磅重。他們龜殼的重量大概佔了他們體重的三分之一。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Claws
entries: 你的利爪是一種天生武器，且你可以用它來進行徒手打擊。如果你以它們命中目標，則你造成等同1d4+你的力量調整值的劈砍傷害，而非一般徒手打擊的鈍擊傷害。

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: 你可以屏住你的呼吸長達1小時。龜人並非天生的游泳健將，但他們在需要浮出水面呼吸空氣之前，可以待在水中好一段時間。

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: 由於你的龜殼和你身體的形狀，你並不適合穿戴護甲。然而，你的龜殼將提供充足的防護；它使你的基礎AC變為17（你的敏捷調整值並不會影響這個數字）。你無法獲得穿戴護甲的好處，但若你使用盾牌，你仍然可以正常應用盾牌的加值。

entries.name: Shell Defense
entries: 你能夠以一個動作縮回殼內。直到你出殼，你的AC將獲得+4加值，且你在力量和體質豁免中具有優勢。當你躲在龜殼內時，你處於{@condition Prone||伏地}狀態，你的移動速度歸零且無法被提升，你在敏捷豁免中具有劣勢，你無法採取反應，且你唯一能做的動作是以一個附贈動作從龜殼裡出來。

entries.name: Survival Instinct
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Survival||求生}技能。龜人磨練出了優秀的求生本能。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語和水族語。

items.name: Alignment
entries: Tritons tend toward neutrality. Their culture encourages them to be mindful of life's currents, knowing when to harness fate's tides and when to flow along with them.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Control Air and Water
entries: You can cast {@spell fog cloud} with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell gust of wind} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell water walk} spell with it. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Emissary of the Sea
entries: You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

entries.name: Guardian of the Depths
entries: Adapted to the frigid ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage.

entries.name: Age
entries: 梭螺魚人在大約15歲時成年，且可以活到最多200年。

entries.name: Size
entries: 梭螺魚人傾向守序善良。身為海洋中最黑暗邊疆的守護者，他們的文化推動他們走向秩序和仁慈。

entries.name: Swim Speed
entries: 梭螺魚人比人類稍微矮一些，身高平均為5呎高。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: 你擁有30呎的游泳速度。

entries.name: Control Air and Water
entries: 你可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 身為海洋之子，你可以呼喚氣和水元素的魔法。你可以使用此特性施放{@spell Fog Cloud||雲霧術}。從3級開始，你可以使用此特性施放{@spell Gust of Wind||造風術}，且從5級開始，你也可以使用此特性施放{@spell Wall of Water|xge|水牆術}。一旦你使用此特性施放一個法術，則直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再用此特性施放該法術。你施展這些法術的施法屬性為魅力。

entries.name: Emissary of the Sea
entries: 水生野獸與你的族人之間有著非凡的親和力。你可以與能在水中呼吸的野獸進行簡單概念的溝通。牠們可以理解你話語的意思，然而你並沒有特殊能力以理解牠們的回覆。

entries.name: Guardians of the Depths
entries: 適應了最極端的深海環境，你具有對寒冰傷害的抗性，且你忽視任何因深水環境所造成的負面影響。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語以及原初語。

entries.name: Chameleon Skin
entries: 你在為躲藏所進行的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Stench
entries: 任何除了戰蜥人以外在距離你5呎內開始它的回合的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 12的體質豁免，否則陷入{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態直到該生物的下個回合開始。若此豁免成功，該生物將免疫於所有戰蜥人的惡臭長達1小時。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當處於日光照耀下時，你在攻擊檢定，以及依賴視覺的睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中具有劣勢。

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: 你的厚皮讓你的護甲等級獲得+1加值。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫戰蜥人語。

entries.name: Age
entries: Vampires don't mature and age in the same way that other races do. Every living vampire is either a bloodchief, infected by Ulamog's influence in the distant reaches of history, or was spawned by a bloodchief from a living human. Most vampires are thus very old, but few have any memory of their earliest years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Vampires have no innate tendency toward evil, but consuming the life energy of other creatures often pushes them to that end. Regardless of their moral bent, the strict hierarchies of their bloodchiefs inclines them toward a lawful alignment.

entries.name: Size
entries: Vampires are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Blood Thirst
entries: You can drain blood and life energy from a willing creature, or one that is {@condition grappled} by you, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. Make a melee attack against the target. If you hit, you deal 1 piercing damage and {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and you regain hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Vampire.

entries.name: Vampiric Resistance
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Age
entries: 維多肯的成長比人類來的緩慢，大約在40歲左右成年。他們的壽命通常是350歲，但有些人可以活到500歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 維多肯通常是守序且非邪惡的。

entries.name: Size
entries: 高且纖瘦，維多肯的身高平均介於6至6½呎之間，且體重通常少於200磅。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Vedalken Dispassion
entries: 你在所有智力、睿知、和魅力的豁免檢定上具有優勢。

entries.name: Tireless Precision
entries: 你熟練於以下其中一個你所選擇的技能：{@skill Arcana||奧秘}、{@skill History||歷史}、{@skill Investigation||調查}、{@skill Medicine||醫藥}、{@skill Performance||表演}、或{@skill Sleight of Hand||手上把戲}。你也熟練於一個你所選擇的工具。
每當你進行一次使用所選的工具或技能的屬性檢定時，骰一顆D4，並將骰出來的數字加到該檢定的總和中。

entries.name: Partially Amphibious
entries: 藉由透過你的肌膚吸收氧氣，你可以在水下呼吸長達1小時。一旦你到達這個極限，直到你完成一次長休之前都不能再使用這個能力。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語、維多肯語、和另一種你所選擇的語言。

entries.name: Age
entries: 維多肯的成熟速度與人類相同，且大多被期許在40歲左右時進入成年生活。他們的壽命可達350歲到甚至500歲。

entries.name: Alignment
entries: 維多肯通常是守序陣營，且很少是邪惡的。

entries.name: Size
entries: 維多肯比人類更高而纖瘦。他們的身高平均介於6至6又1/2呎之間，且體重通常少於200磅。你的體型為中型。

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Vedalken. The Vedalken language is renowned for its technical treatises and its catalogs of knowledge about the natural world and the aether that pervades it.

entries.name: Vedalken Cunning
entries: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Aether Lore
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) check related to magic items or aether-powered technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

entries.name: Age
entries: Verdan reach adulthood at around the age of 24, and it is thought that they might live to nearly 200 years old. However, because no verdan has died of old age since the race's initial creation, their upper age limits remain subject to speculation.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Verdan are generally good, although their absence of racial identity and shared history can sometimes see individual verdan become untethered from any moral or ethical framework.

entries.name: Size
entries: Verdan start out similar in size to the goblins they were created from, ranging from 3 to 4 feet in height. But at some point after reaching maturity, each verdan undergoes a sudden growth spurt of 2 feet or more. At 1st level, you are a Small creature. When you reach 5th level, you become a Medium creature.

entries.name: Black Blood Healing
entries: The black blood that is a sign of your people's connection to That-Which-Endures boosts your natural healing. When you roll a 1 or 2 on any Hit Die you spend at the end of a short rest, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: You can telepathically speak to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathy, but it must be able to understand at least one language. This process of communication is slow and limited, allowing you to transmit and receive only simple ideas and straightforward concepts.

entries.name: Persuasive
entries: Your people's lack of history makes you trustworthy and humble. You have proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion} skill.

entries.name: Telepathic Insight
entries: Your mind's connection to the world around you strengthens your will. You have advantage on all Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Language
entries: You speak, read, and write Common, Goblin, and one additional language of your choice. This language typically has some connection to one of the areas or cultures that has been part of your life.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 6-8 feet tall) or Small (about 3-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Construct Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Integrated Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. In addition, armor you have donned can't be removed against your will while you're alive.

entries.name: Sentry's Rest
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in 6 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state. During this time, you appear inert but remain conscious.

entries.name: Specialized Design
entries: You gain one skill proficiency and one tool proficiency of your choice.

entries.name: Tireless
entries: You don't gain {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.

entries.name: Age
entries: A typical warforged is between two and thirty years old. The maximum warforged lifespan remains a mystery; so far, warforged have shown no signs of deterioration due to age. You are immune to magical aging effects.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most warforged take comfort in order and discipline, tending toward law and neutrality. But some have absorbed the morality, or lack thereof, of the beings with which they served.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Constructed Resilience
entries: You were created to have remarkable fortitude, represented by the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}, and you have resistance to poison damage.
You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.
You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Sentry's Rest
entries: When you take a long rest, you must spend at least six hours in an inactive, motionless state, rather than sleeping. In this state, you appear inert, but it doesn't render you {@condition unconscious}, and you can see and hear as normal.

entries.name: Integrated Protection
entries: Your body has built-in defensive layers, which can be enhanced with armor:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

You can don only armor with which you have proficiency. To don armor other than a shield, you must incorporate it into your body over the course of 1 hour, during which you remain in contact with the armor. To doff armor, you must spend 1 hour removing it. You can rest while donning or doffing armor in this way.
While you live, the armor incorporated into your body can't be removed against your will.

entries.name: Specialized Design
entries: You gain one skill proficiency and one tool proficiency of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

entries.name: Poison Resilience
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

entries.name: Serpentine Spellcasting
entries: You know the {@spell poison spray} cantrip. You can cast {@spell animal friendship} an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast {@spell suggestion} with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Age
entries: Purebloods mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.

entries.name: Size
entries: Purebloods match humans in average size and weight. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: 你知曉{@spell Poison Spray||毒氣噴灑}戲法。你能夠使用此特性無限次的施放{@spell Animal Friendship||化獸為友}，但你只能指定蛇類做為它的目標。從3級開始，你也可以使用此特性施放{@spell Suggestion||暗示術}。一旦你施放它，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再這麼做。你施展這些法術的施法屬性為魅力。

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: 你在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Poison Immunity
entries: 你免疫於毒素傷害和{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你可以說、讀、寫通用語、深淵語、和龍語。

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are Undead.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: 若傷害將你的生命值歸零，除非該傷害為光耀傷害或來自重擊，否則你必須進行一次DC 5+所受傷害值的體質豁免。若豁免成功，則你改為將生命值減少至1。

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: 你免疫於毒素傷害和{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，且你不會陷入{@condition Poisoned||中毒}狀態。你不再需要呼吸、進食、飲水、或睡眠。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你無法說話，但你可以理解任何你生前所知的語言。

items.name: Age
entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens. Most human initiates have completed the trials and found a glorious or inglorious death before they turn 30. Viziers can enjoy longer service to their gods, in theory living up to a century.

items.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

items.name: Alignment
entries: Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and the worst are found among them.

entries.name: Necrotic Shroud
entries: 從3級開始，你可以使用你的動作以釋放你體內的神性能量，這將使你的雙眼轉變為一團黑暗，並從你的背上長出一對幽靈般，無法飛行的骨翼。在你轉變的瞬間，所有距離你10呎內且可以看見你的其他生物必須成功通過一次魅力豁免（DC 8+你的熟練加值+你的魅力調整值），否則將因你陷入{@condition Frightened||恐懼}直到你的下個回合結束。
你的轉變將會持續1分鐘，或直到你以一個附贈動作結束它。在轉變期間，在你的每個回合一次，你可以在以一次攻擊或法術對一個目標造成傷害時對它造成額外的死靈傷害。這個額外的死靈傷害等同於你的等級。
一旦你使用這個特性，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Radiant Soul
entries: 從3級開始，你可以使用你的動作以釋放你體內的神性能量，這將使你的雙眼綻放光芒，並從你的背上長出一對輝煌的無實體羽翼。
你的轉變將會持續1分鐘，或直到你以一個附贈動作結束它。在轉變期間，你具有30呎的飛行速度，且在你的每個回合一次，你可以在以一次攻擊或法術對一個目標造成傷害時對它造成額外的光耀傷害。這個額外的光耀傷害等同於你的等級。
一旦你使用這個特性，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Radiant Consumption
entries: 從3級開始，你可以使用你的動作以釋放你體內的神性能量，這將使灼熱的光芒從你身上輻射而出，並從你的雙眼和口中湧出，威脅著就你焚燒殆盡。
你的轉變將會持續1分鐘，或直到你以一個附贈動作結束它。在轉變期間，你將散發出10呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸10呎的微光光照，且在你的每個回合結束時，你和每個距離你10呎內的生物都將受到等同於你等級一半（向上取整）的光耀傷害。此外，在你的每個回合一次，你可以在以一次攻擊或法術對一個目標造成傷害時對它造成額外的光耀傷害。這個額外的光耀傷害等同於你的等級。
一旦你使用這個特性，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: Hawkeyed
entries: 你熟練於{@skill Perception||感知}技能。此外，攻擊長射程範圍中的目標並不會讓你的遠程武器攻擊檢定因此承受劣勢。

entries.name: Kefnet's Blessing
entries: 你可以將你熟練加值的一半（向下取整）加入任何未加入你熟練加值的智力檢定中。

items.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a {{area}}.

When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a {{savingThrow}} saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} {{damageType}} damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} at 6th level, {@damage 4d6} at 11th level, and {@damage 5d6} at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

items.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have resistance to {{damageType}} damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Forceful Presence
entries: You can use your understanding of creative diplomacy or intimidation to guide a conversation in your favor. When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check, you can do so with advantage. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Draconic Ancestry
entries: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon is determined by the dragon type, as shown in the table.

items.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a {{area}}.

When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a {{savingThrow}} saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} {{damageType}} damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} at 6th level, {@damage 4d6} at 11th level, and {@damage 5d6} at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Vengeful Assault
entries: When you take damage from a creature in range of a weapon you are wielding, you can use your reaction to make an attack with the weapon against that creature. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Draconic Ancestry
entries: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon is determined by the dragon type, as shown in the table.

items.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a {{area}}.

When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a {{savingThrow}} saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} {{damageType}} damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} at 6th level, {@damage 4d6} at 11th level, and {@damage 5d6} at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: 習慣了地底的生活，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你120呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: 你在對抗毒素的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且你對毒素傷害具有抗性。你也在對抗幻術以及對抗{@condition Charmed||魅惑}或{@condition Paralyzed||麻痺}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫通用語、矮人語、和地底通用語。

entries.name: Duergar Magic
entries: 當你升至3級，你每天可以使用此特性對你自己施放一次{@spell Enlarge/Reduce||變巨/縮小術}，但只能使用變巨的選項。當你升至5級，你每天可以使用此特性對你自己施放一次{@spell Invisibility||隱形術}。你不需要為這些法術提供材料構材，且你不能在自己暴露於陽光下時施放它們，儘管一旦施放後，陽光對它們不會有任何影響。你在完成一次長休後才能恢復再次使用此特性施放這些法術的能力。你施展這些法術的施法屬性為智力。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當你、你的攻擊目標、或你嘗試感知的東西直接暴露在陽光下，則你依賴於視覺的攻擊檢定以及睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定具有劣勢。

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: 你的生命值最大值增加1點，且在每次你提升等級時再增加1點。

entries.name: Warder's Intuition
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check or an ability check using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Wards and Seals
entries: You can cast the {@spell alarm} and {@spell mage armor} spells with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast the {@spell arcane lock} spell with it. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you don't need material components for them when you cast them with this trait.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Warding Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

entries.caption: Mark of Warding Spells
rows: {@spell Leomund's secret chest}, {@spell Mordenkainen's faithful hound}

entries.name: Dwarven Armor Training
entries: 你熟練於輕甲和中甲。

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: 習慣了幽暗地域的深處，你在黑暗與微光環境下仍能保持卓越視覺。你在看距離你120呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你無法辨別黑暗中的顏色，而只能看到灰黑的輪廓。

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 當你、你的攻擊目標、或你嘗試感知的東西直接暴露在陽光下，則你依賴於視覺的攻擊檢定以及睿知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定具有劣勢。

entries.name: Drow Magic
entries: 你知曉{@spell Dancing Lights||舞光術}戲法。當你升至3級，你每天可以施放一次{@spell Faerie Fire||妖火術}；你必須完成一次長休才能再次使用此特性施放該法術。當你升至5級，你每天可以施放一次{@spell Darkness||黑暗術}；你必須完成一次長休才能再次使用此特性施放該法術。你施展該法術的施法屬性為魅力。

entries.name: Drow Weapon Training
entries: 你熟練於{@item Rapier|phb|刺劍}、{@item Shortsword|phb|短劍}、和{@item Hand Crossbow|phb|手弩}。

entries.name: Elf Weapon Training
entries: 你熟練於{@item Longsword|phb|長劍}、{@item Shortsword|phb|短劍}、{@item Shortbow|phb|短弓}、和{@item Longbow|phb|長弓}。

entries.name: Fey Step
entries: 你可以使用此特性施放一次{@spell Misty Step||迷蹤步}。當你完成一次短休或長休，你將重新獲得施放該法術的能力。

subrace.name: Eladrin
entries: {@i 選擇你的雅靈季節：春、夏、秋或冬。當完成一次長休，一個雅靈將可以改變他的季節。參見"情報"頁以獲得更多資訊。}

entries.name: Fey Step
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以魔法性的傳送最多30呎距離到一處未被佔據的可見空間。一旦你使用此特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前都無法再使用它。
當你升至3級，你的妖精步將根據你的季節獲得一個額外效果；若該效果需要豁免，則DC等同8+你的熟練加值+你的魅力調整值：

items.name: Autumn
items.entry: 當你使用妖精步時，你可以觸碰一個距離你5呎內的自願生物。該生物將代替你被傳送，並出現在距離你30呎內的一處未被佔據的可見空間。

items.name: Winter
items.entry: 緊接在你使用妖精步後，距離你5呎內每個你所選擇的生物將受到等同於你魅力調整值的火焰傷害（最少1點）。

items.name: Spring
items.entry: 緊接在你使用妖精步後，距離你10呎內最多二個你所選擇的生物必須成功通過一次睿知豁免，否則被你{@condition Charmed||魅惑}1分鐘，或直到你或你的同伴對它造成傷害。

items.name: Summer
items.entry: 當你使用妖精步時，一個你所選擇在你傳送前距離你5呎內的可見生物必須成功通過一次睿知豁免，否則對你感到{@condition Frightened||恐懼}直到你的下個回合結束。

entries.name: Elf Weapon Training
entries: 你熟練於{@item Longsword|phb|長劍}、{@item Shortsword|phb|短劍}、{@item Shortbow|phb|短弓}、和{@item Longbow|phb|長弓}。

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: 你知曉一個{@filter 從法師法術列表中自選的戲法|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}。你施展該法術的施法屬性為智力。

entries.name: Extra Language
entries: 你可以額外說、讀、寫一種你選擇的語言。

entries.name: Cunning Intuition
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) or Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Shape Shadows
entries: You know the {@spell minor illusion} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell invisibility} spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Shadow Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

entries.caption: Mark of Shadow Spells
rows: {@spell disguise self||易容術}, {@spell silent image||無聲幻影}
{@spell darkness||黑暗術}, {@spell pass without trace||行蹤無跡}
{@spell clairvoyance||銳眼術}, {@spell major image||強效幻影}
{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}, {@spell hallucinatory terrain||幻景}

entries.name: Incisive Sense
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) and Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks.

entries.name: Blessing of the Moon Weaver
entries: You know the {@spell light} cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell sleep} spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the {@spell invisibility} spell (targeting yourself only) once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Casting these spells with this trait doesn't require material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Sea Elf Training
entries: 你熟練於{@item Spear|phb|矛}、{@item Trident|phb|三叉戟}、{@item Light Crossbow|phb|輕弩}、和{@item Net|phb|捕網}。

entries.name: Child of the Sea
entries: 你擁有30呎的游泳速度，且你可以在空氣與水中呼吸。

entries.name: Friend of the Sea
entries: 利用手勢與聲音，你可以和任何擁有天生游泳速度的野獸溝通簡單的想法。

entries.name: Extra Language
entries: 你能夠說、讀、寫水族語。

entries.name: Necrotic Resistance
entries: 你具有對死靈傷害的抗性。

entries.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以魔法性的傳送最多30呎距離到一處未被佔據的可見空間。一旦你使用此特性，直到你完成一次長休之前都無法再使用它。
從3級開始，當你使用此特性傳送時，你也獲得對所有傷害的抗性。這個抗性持續到你的下個回合開始。在這段期間，你變得朦朧且半透明。

entries.name: Elf Weapon Training

entries.name: Fleet of Foot
entries: 你的基礎步行速度提升到35呎。

entries.name: Mask of the Wild

entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Skill Versatility
entries: 你熟練於總共二種自選技能或工具。

entries.name: Unending Breath
entries: 當你並未{@condition Incapacitated||無力}，你就可以無限期的屏住呼吸。

entries.name: Mingle with the Wind
entries: 你可以使用此特性施放一次{@spell Levitate||浮空術}，無需任何材料構材，且當你完成一次長休，你將重新獲得施放該法術的能力。你施展該法術的施法屬性為體質。

entries.name: Earth Walk
entries: 你可以移動穿越由土或石構成的困難地形而不會消耗額外的移動速度。

entries.name: Merge with Stone
entries: 你可以使用此特性施放一次{@spell Pass without Trace||行蹤無跡}，無需任何材料構材，且當你完成一次長休，你將重新獲得施放該法術的能力。你施展該法術的施法屬性為體質。

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: 你在看距離你60呎範圍內的事物時，微光的照明程度對你而言視作明亮，黑暗則視作微光。你與火元素位面的聯系使你的黑暗視覺與眾不同：任何你在黑暗中所看到的事物都有著紅色的輪廓。

entries.name: Reach to the Blaze
entries: 你知曉{@spell Produce Flame||燃火術}戲法。當你升至3級，你可以使用此特性以一環法術施放一次{@spell Burning Hands||燃燒之手}，無需任何材料構材，且當你完成一次長休，你將重新獲得施放該法術的能力。你施展該法術的施法屬性為體質。
